limits: Assistant-run source curation and internal AI annotation are not independent human review, blind/population evidence or exhaustive novelty audit.

Different repository identities and exclusion register do not rule out pretraining/history/shared ancestry or dependencies on exposed repositories. Selected production labels are not generator-only but are a convenience sample.
Explicit full AST declaration evidence is source text, not inherited/transitive concrete implementation closure; natural bodies are ungradeable.
Visible fenced-text and structured results[].content completeness are separate interface-specific additive measures, never interchangeable.
No SOTA, general unseen-project superiority, coding productivity, causal speedup or population claim.
Identical canonical inputs do not guarantee equal processed/indexed coverage; fixed supported errors remain zero and in denominator.
Runtime supplement binds actual supplied file/runtime bytes, not recursively complete OS/dyld/shared-cache or live model file closure.

bodyPolicy.primary: Exact relevant-file Hit@5 from first ten distinct file paths in visible numbered citations, preserving response order. 50 raw hits requested. Primary unchanged from sound prior public MCP study; first pass only.

explicitBodyChannels.visibleFencedText: Only an actually returned closed fenced-text body attached to a visible numbered citation. Do not use structured content to repair visible truncation. Header parsing ignores lines inside fences.
explicitBodyChannels.structuredResultsContent: Only actual raw MCP structuredContent.results[].content strings, ordered as the returned results array and capped at 50 raw results. Do not use fenced text to repair absent or truncated structured content. Missing structured channel is an observed absence (explicit-body score0), not an inferred body.

structuredLocationAdapter.locationContainer: nested location object if present, otherwise result itself
structuredLocationAdapter.noOtherFallback: No JSON string parsing, participant-specific alias additions, cross-result body concatenation, or reconstructive source fallback after freeze.

bodyPolicy.channelMetricsAt5: Each channel independently reports target identity, original supporting overlap/coverage, full declaration inclusive-line range coverage, exact complete AST-node text present in a single returned body, complete text AND range, and exact body versus cited original source slice. Body metrics use raw result/citation rank<=5; file metrics use deduplicated file order. Text-and-range visible metric is additive for this new study only; historical reports untouched.
bodyPolicy.gold: Unique full upstream Tree-sitter AST declaration node selected independently of OCBI; exact byte offsets, complete text, SHA256, inclusive source line range/text/hash, full file hash and original separately-labelled supporting ranges frozen. No selected-node or selected-file parse errors. No whitespace/indentation/code omission normalization in exact full-node text comparison.
bodyPolicy.provenance: Canonical archives and full source manifests verify path containment, exact source bytes and valid ranges. Original and per-cell source hashes checked. Source readback never adds omitted consumer body text.
bodyPolicy.naturalBodyGradeability: UNGRADABLE/N/A: codebase_peek and natural labels are file-only. No implementation body/span score, no zero substituted for ungradeability.
bodyPolicy.closureGradeability: No semantic equivalence, inherited behavior, cross-file/transitive implementation closure, execution correctness or coding productivity grade.
